# Source: Distant View of Niagara Falls

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Distant View of Niagara Falls
- **Artist / culture:** Thomas Cole (American, born England, 1801–1848)
- **Date:** 1830
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** painting
- **Department:** Arts of the Americas
- **AIC artwork ID:** 90048
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/90048
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/18092196-50ae-3ff1-9205-1b3110e966c3/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Chinese Landscape

## Extracted source palette

`#281808, #383828, #482808, #686858, #584838, #E8D8B8, #080808, #887868`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#150C04`
- `surface`: `#302821`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#482808`
- `on_primary`: `#F8F8F6`
- `secondary`: `#E8D8B8`
- `surface_variant`: `#302821`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#554E48`
- `error`: `#482808`
- `on_error`: `#F8F8F6`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `18.18:1`, surface `13.61:1`
- Variant contrast: `13.61:1`
- Control contrast: `12.48:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
